question: How is a rental priced?
tag: One price for 3 days [window_standard]  (neutral, gold deep)
text: Every rental piece has one price for its standard rental window of 3 days [window_standard]: it arrives the day
before your celebration, is yours for the day itself, and goes back the day after. Here is how the window works
[opens page shipping-policy].
Each piece also has a daily rate for every additional day, shown on its page. Both are set for each piece, by its
designer, its value and its condition, and your booking summary adds everything up before you pay.
keywords: price rental cost how much window daily rate days per day charge fee priced

question: How do extra days work?
tag: Daily rate per day  (neutral, gold deep)
text: Simply add one extra day for each additional day of celebrations, at the piece's daily rate. With a haldi and sangeet
on one day and the wedding the next, you would book your standard 3 days [window_standard] plus 1 extra day.
See it in numbers [scrolls to In numbers].
Once your piece is with you, you can still ask to keep it longer [opens answer x-extend]. If no one has booked it
straight after you, each extra day costs the same daily rate.
keywords: extra days longer extend extension more days wedding functions haldi sangeet mehendi multiple add week

question: What is included in the rental price?
text: Everything that keeps the piece at its best, and everything you need to enjoy it:
• professional cleaning before your rental, and again after it
• pressing, careful checks and any small touch-ups
• its garment bag and box, wrapped in tissue
• a prepaid return label, so sending it back costs nothing more
You never pay for cleaning, and please never clean the piece yourself. Our Care, Cleaning & Damage Policy
[opens page care-policy] explains why.
keywords: included cleaning dry clean pressing packaging garment bag box return label what is included free

question: Is GST included in the rental price?
text: Rental prices are shown before GST. GST at 18% [gst_rental] is added to your rental fee at checkout, and you
see the exact amount before you pay.
Your deposit carries no GST, because it is held for you rather than paid to us.
keywords: gst tax included exclusive inclusive 18 percent rental price

text: Each piece has its own price for the window you share, and every piece booked for the same dates travels

text: Each rental piece has its own deposit, set to protect it and shown on its page before you book. It is held in

or bank transfer, 10 days [deposit_due_before] before your piece is dispatched. For a booking made closer to the
date, it is due within 48 hours [deposit_late_booking] of our request, and always before dispatch.
Cash is welcome only for bookings made in person with us in Indore. We confirm receipt in writing within 48 hours
[deposit_receipt_within].

text: Never. If our regular cleaning and small touch-ups after every rental put it right, it is normal wear, and it is
never charged. Natural perspiration is never charged either.

decided against the photographs and video we take before dispatch, and shared with you first. It carries no GST,
because it restores the piece rather than paying for anything.
If the cost is more than your deposit, the balance is settled within 7 days [balance_due] of our written statement,
once we have talked it through with you. Our Care, Cleaning & Damage Policy [opens page care-policy] explains
more.

question: How is my share decided?
text: Your share is set for each piece and discussed openly with you before it goes live. It reflects your piece's value
and condition, and the effort it takes from our team to rent or sell it: collecting and cleaning it, photographing it
beautifully, and marketing it to the right people.
Whatever the piece, our aim stays the same: that you recover a meaningful part of what you invested in it,
and that we keep only what truly reflects our work for it. Your share is then confirmed in its Listing Terms.
keywords: share how decided set percentage commission per piece value condition effort marketing listing terms

question: Is there a fixed share for every piece?
tag: Agreed piece by piece  (neutral, gold deep)
text: No, and that is deliberate. Every piece is different: some find their first renter almost at once, while others need
more of our time, care and marketing to reach the right person.
So rather than one figure for everyone, we agree a share for your piece with you before it goes live, and every
payout statement shows exactly how it was worked out. Here is how your share is decided [opens answer e-how].
keywords: fixed typical standard same every piece share percentage rate how much keep earn commission cut

question: What is my share calculated on?
text: On the rental fee of each booking, and on the final price of a sale, including an offer we have accepted.
GST, deposits and delivery charges are never part of it: GST goes to the government, a deposit is the renter's own
money held in safekeeping, and delivery pays for the journey.

your income tax return.
